rules.name: Precise Hit
rules.description: This unit may re-roll all failed scores in the Weapon Skill Test

rules.name: Magic Runes
rules.description: A successful Prayer Test of this unit means that the unit can use the rules of two different prayers instead of one. Such additional prayer does not decrease the pool of prayers.

rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: This unit can make a free move before the battle. Additionally, the enemy cannot use the charge bonuses and independent bonuses while charging this unit

rules.name: Trample
rules.description: For each successful score in the Weapon Skill Test, roll an additional d6. Additional successful scores do not generate new ones

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Ice is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, make a d6 test before the enemy attacks. A score of 3 or less means that the enemy unit gets a -1 to WS modifier in the Weapon Skill Test until the end of the cycle

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Fire is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, make a d6 test before the fight. A score of 3 or less means the unit gets 3 additional dice in the Wound Test until the end of the cycle

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After activating the Champion of Storm, select an enemy unit within 30 cm and roll a d6 for each rank in that unit. Each score of 4 or less means that the unit is dealt 1 Wound. The unit is not protected by any armour or other protection.

rules.name: Priest of the Old Gods
rules.description:
Priest of the Old Gods is on the battlefield, an additionalfriendly unit can make a prayer
*Note – this is an ADDITIONAL prayer to the one provided by the priest, this model gives you TWO in total

rules.name: Fortune-teller
rules.description: Fortune-teller is within 10 cm of the Great Hunter during the Activation Roll, the player can make a d6 test once per cycle. A score of 3 or less means that the Activation Roll score may be modified by +1 or -2

rules.name: Devoted to Gods
rules.description: Basic and Elite Units in the Dirandis army may re-roll failed Prayer Tests

rules.name: The Crusher
rules.description: This mysterious artifact hammer causes Pakun to support a unit with 6 attacks plus additional attacks equal to a d6 roll. Additionally, the unit Pakun supports changes its Strength (S) to 4 if it has less

rules.name: Dark Humour
rules.description: If Pakun is attached to the Half-giants unit, the unit may add or substract 1 from its LD during any test.

rules.name: Oklar
rules.description: An enemy unit that attacks a unit that Pakun is attached to must substract 3 dice from the pool.

sharedRules.name: Focused Attack
sharedRules.description: When charging, this unit gets +1 to WS

sharedRules.name: Light Shield Defence
sharedRules.description: For each Wound dealt to this unit, roll a d6 for the light shield defence. Each score of 1 means a cancelled Wound
